12 / Cybersecurity

Rana — A digital legacy and message-to-the-future platform

A time capsule where encrypted messages open only on a scheduled date.

Year
2026
Scope
Cybersecurity
  • E2E
    end-to-end encryption — invisible even to admins
  • 3
    message formats — text, voice, video
  • 2
    platforms — iOS and Android

01 / Overview

Rana is a time-capsule solution that securely delivers memories, important messages and digital legacy to future generations. Users schedule messages for family members years ahead; the data is encrypted and opens only on a predetermined date, for the chosen heirs.

02 / The problem

Digital legacy — passwords, documents, family videos — is usually not organised anywhere. Storing it in the cloud means the provider or an administrator could, in principle, read it.

03 / Our approach

Content is end-to-end encrypted, so no third party, administrators included, can reach videos or messages. Large video and audio files are stored asynchronously in encrypted cloud storage to keep the database light, and the backend is set up for high availability with Docker and Nginx.

04 / The result

A user can schedule a video message, a document or a will for their child’s 18th birthday. When the time comes, the recipient is notified by SMS, email or push notification, and the content opens only at that moment.

05 / Key features

What it does.

  • 01

    Time capsule

    Schedule text, voice or video messages for a specific future date and time.

  • 02

    Digital legacy and will

    Store documents, passwords and wills securely and pass them to heirs when the time comes.

  • 03

    Smart notifications

    Recipients are notified at the scheduled time by SMS, email or push.

  • 04

    Premium UI/UX

    A refined, minimalist interface with navigation suited to every age group.

06 / Architecture

How it is built.

  1. End-to-end encryption

    Custom cryptography, so no third party — the administrator included — can access content.

  2. Secure blob storage

    Large video and audio files are stored asynchronously in encrypted cloud storage.

  3. Containerised infrastructure

    The backend is isolated with Docker and set up for high availability behind an Nginx reverse proxy.

07 / Technology

Tech stack.

Backend
  • .NET Core API
Mobile
  • React Native with Expo
Database

File storage

Infrastructure
  • Docker
  • Nginx
  • PM2
